description: “The bottom line is that our community, and those like it around the state, are at a breaking point. As a legislator, as a former law enforcement officer, as a father, and as a private citizen, I say no more half-measures, no more half-baked ‘solutions.’ We need to take action, right now, and I am ready to get to work.”
